Great to connect earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups from our discovery:

- Usage: you mentioned an initial pilot (~10M tokens/month), with production ramp target of ~50M tokens/month within 3–6 months.
- Goals: keep unit economics in the ballpark of $/1M tokens that hit your finance targets (you referenced ~$700/1M as an upper bound).

High-level (very rough):
- Baseline (hosted, pay-as-you-go) US: ballpark $600–750 per 1M tokens depending on model family and caching.
- EU premium: typically ~8–15% higher due to regional infra and cross-region capacity; expect +~12% on average.
- Reserved pricing: 10–25% off baseline depending on term and committed volume — biggest gains at 6–12 month commits.

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm the expected 1st year avg monthly tokens (pilot vs steady state)?
2) Any hard budget constraints (e.g., target $/1M token you need to hit)?
3) Which EU region(s) do you need (e.g., eu-west-1, eu-central-1)?

I’ll attach a short pricing spreadsheet and a draft SOW for procurement to start the formal quote. Dylan (cc) will add concrete unit numbers by region.

Hi all — adding the concrete numbers Marissa asked for. Notes: these are list/starting points; reserved commit examples assume billing to a single account and a 12-month term unless noted otherwise. Effective unit with caching assumes typical prefix reuse and batching for chat traffic; your actual could be better/worse depending on prompt patterns.

1) Pay-as-you-go (hosted API) per 1M tokens (list):
   - US (us-west / us-east): $650 per 1M tokens
   - EU (eu-west / eu-central): $728 per 1M tokens (+12% typical premium)

2) Committed (reserved capacity) per 1M tokens, example bands (12-mo):
   - 50M/mo commit: 20% discount vs list -> US: $520 /1M, EU: $622 /1M
   - 150M/mo commit: 25% discount vs list -> US: $487 /1M, EU: $610 /1M

3) Effective-unit with caching/prefix reuse: we commonly see 10–30% effective reduction depending on workload. With conservative assumptions (15% effective reduction):
   - US baseline $650 -> ~$553 effective /1M
   - EU baseline $728 -> ~$619 effective /1M

4) Other levers: model selection matters (smaller distil variants reduce cost), quantized serving or batching settings can shift unit costs further.

Residency & logs:
- Data plane: EU-hosted inference keeps inference requests and KV cache in-region. We can guarantee model execution within EU regional pools.
- Control plane & audit logs: we offer an EU-only control plane option for Private deployments and an EU tenancy for Dedicated; for hosted customers we can configure log retention and log export to your EU SIEM via partner connectors (we will surface SOC2 evidence and regional logging options in the SOW).

Attachments: pricing-breakdown-us-eu.csv (line-by-line), SOW-draft-FintechCo.pdf (SOW template). I attached both to this thread for procurement.

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk line items.
